description: This source file defines a HomeFragment class using Android's Leanback library to create a TV-optimized browsing UI with multiple horizontal rows of movie/TV show cards, custom card presenters, and focus animations. It includes data models, presenter classes, and UI build logic.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A fragment that builds a TV-optimized home screen with multiple rows of cards, using Leanback library components.

classes.name: CardItem
classes.description: Data model representing a card with a title, image resource, and optional progress indicator.

classes.name: CardPresenterSelector
classes.description: A PresenterSelector returning a custom presenter for CardItems.

classes.name: OPImageCardPresenter
classes.description: A custom Presenter that creates and binds ImageCardView instances with focus animations, custom sizing, and an integrated progress bar.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a ViewHolder wrapping an ImageCardView with customized focus behavior.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a CardItem to the ViewHolder, including setting the image, title, and a custom progress bar overlay.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Clears the image resource from the view to free memory.

methods.name: buildProgressBar
methods.description: Constructs a horizontal progress bar view indicating playback progress.
